# Mega-tile tables (pMegaTiles) the Pass3 expansion reads — sha256 of the raw
# archive member each CSV re-encodes to, byte for byte.
# .til is pMegaTiles, and DRLG_LPass3 (gendung.cpp:591) reads only that table.
# The .min members are NOT Pass3 input: they are the level-pieces table
# SetDungeonMicros reads (dun_tile_data.cpp:69,180) to build the sub-tile render
# micros, pinned here because the probe extracts both per level family.
# The .sol member is SOLData (dun_tile_data.hpp:81), one TileProperties byte per
# sub-tile the renderer classifies; CreateL3Dungeon's nest branch loads
# l6.sol verbatim (dun_tile_data.cpp:154), 606 bytes, below MAXTILES (1379).
# town.til.csv comes from hellfire.mpq nlevels/towndata/town.til (376 mega
# tiles, the table GetTileCount(DTYPE_TOWN) sizes); its first 342 tiles are
# byte-identical to DIABDAT.MPQ levels/towndata/town.til, so the town dPiece is
# the same with or without the hellfire archives loaded.
# source: DIABDAT.MPQ levels/lNdata/lN.til and levels/lNdata/lN.min, extracted
#         with cmd/devilutionGo-migrate (DG_ASSET_ARCHIVES, ADR-005); three
#         independent extraction runs (2026-11-05) agree byte-identically.
#         l6.* come from hellfire.mpq nlevels/l6data (LoadLvlGFX,
#         diablo.cpp:1409-1413) via `dunconv assets <hellfire.mpq> <dir>`; two
#         extraction runs (2026-11-06) agree byte-identically.
# format: uint16 LE count, uint16 LE cols, count*cols uint16 LE values;
#         .til has cols=4 (micro1..micro4 per mega tile), .min cols=1;
#         .sol re-encodes the same shape as one byte per value.
